title: South Carolina bar shooting leaves four people dead and 20 injured, officials say
summary: Shooting occurred early Sunday at Willie’s Bar and Grill on idyllic St Helena island A mass shooting at a crowded bar on an idyllic South Carolina island has left four people dead and at least 20 injured, officials say. The shooting occurred early Sunday at Willie’s Bar and Grill on St Helena island, officials said. A large crowd was at the scene when sheriff’s deputies arrived and found several people suffering from gunshot wounds. Continue reading...
